rules.statement: A deed executed before the institution of the case and tendered to court must be accepted as a document by which a party became entitled to a share of the corpus.
rules.supporting_quote: This deed 4D2 which gives rights to 10 perches of the corpus to the 4th Defendant has been tendered to court and I therefore hold that the Deed No.6182 marked as 4D2 must be accepted as a document by which the 4th Defendant became entitled to 10 perches and this 10 perches should be added to the 63/7560 shares already allotted to the 4th Defendant by the judgment entered in this case.
